_comment: Cross-language pin for the detector camera's mount pitch. Not a wire message -- the wire-message harness (conftest.py / validate_py_test.py / validate_ts.test.ts) generates StateUpdate/SceneDescription/Ack frames from a live Python Simulation and has no path for a bare scalar. This file exists so schema.ts's MOUNT_PITCH_RAD and schema.py's geometry tests both assert against ONE committed number instead of two independently hand-transcribed literals that could silently drift apart -- see streetlab/tests/detectorCamera.test.ts and streetlab-backend/tests/test_geometry_projection.py for what reads this file.
_formula: -atan2(mount_drop_m, aim_forward_m - MOUNT_FORWARD_M) = -atan2(0.18, 40 - 0.15), radians, negative = nose-down (see streetlab/src/three/detectorCamera.ts's MOUNT_PITCH_RAD and perception/geometry.py's CameraParams.pitch convention)
_note: The value below is TypeScript's own computed value (`-Math.atan2(0.18, 40 - 0.15)`), taken as canonical because MOUNT_PITCH_RAD is what actually reaches the wire. Python's math.atan2 recomputation of the same formula differs from this by 1 ULP (different libm implementation) -- test_geometry_projection.py's check therefore compares with a tolerance, not exact equality; detectorCamera.test.ts compares with ===, since re-parsing this literal in JS reproduces the exact same double MOUNT_PITCH_RAD already is.
